context: Owner private PDF authorization page showed Failed to fetch after owner capability was already bound
rootCause: public/private-pdf-owner-setup.html preflighted https://api.gczhouwld.com/api/_healthcheck from gallery.gczhouwld.com; the healthcheck route is not a browser-CORS route, so the browser rejected the cross-origin fetch
fix: Remove the healthcheck preflight from the owner page. Existing authenticated private_pdf_capture capability enables the button; POST /api/user-ui/private-pdf/capture-lease remains the authoritative capability plus server kill-switch check and already carries browser CORS.

tests.chromiumRegression: owner authorization succeeds even when healthcheck is intentionally unreachable

nextUserAction: Open the cache-busted owner setup page while logged in, then click 授权本浏览器抓取 PDF（7 天）. No owner re-binding is needed.
